newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 13.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 13.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Australia's biggest retailer reported a sharply higher half year net profit of A$273.6 million and said it expected similar growth in profit in the second half of the year ending July 31, 1997.

Gold miners St Barbara said on Wednesday it proposed to merge with fellow gold miner Mt Leyshon, the offer being 32 St Barbara shares for every 10 Mt Leyshon shares. Mt Leyshon, owned 75 percent by the Normandy Mining said it was receptive to the offer. Based on Wednesday's closing prices, the offer values Mt Leyshon at about A$2.50 per share.

On Wednesday, upmarket retailer David Jones Ltd reported a 50 percent lower first half net profit of A$22.34 million and said it expects its pre-tax profit for the second half to be below the previous year. The company also announced Just Jeans managing director Peter Wilkinson as a replacement for Chris Tideman, who resigned on Monday.
Chemicals and plastic maker due to report half year results. Previous corresponding half the company reported a net profit of A$4.92 million.
